subject: Emotions
title: Reading Body Language
description: A fast breakdown of Reading Body Language for builders.

hook.text: A colleague says 'I'm fine' while crossing his arms and looking at the door. Which message do you believe?

buildup.text: Albert Mehrabian found that when words and body language conflict, people trust body language 93% of the time.

discovery.text: Body language includes posture, gestures, proximity, and touch. Each channel sends emotional information simultaneously.

twist.text: Mehrabian's often-cited '93% rule' applies only to ambiguous situations. In clear contexts, words matter much more.

climax.text: The best communicators read clusters, not single cues. Crossed arms alone means nothing; with other signals, it speaks.

punchline.text: Bodies broadcast what mouths won't say.

quiz.question: When does body language override words, per Mehrabian?
